name: pagespeed
description: PageSpeed and Core Web Vitals: tracks field data from the Chrome UX Report and Lighthouse lab scores for your key pages, with daily trends.

api_key.title: Google API key
api_key.description: A key with the PageSpeed Insights API and the Chrome UX Report API enabled. Stored here and never shown again.

urls.title: Pages to track
urls.description: One path per line, for example /pricing. Leave empty to track the home page and the 24 most recently published pages.

public_url.title: Public address of this site
public_url.description: For example https://example.com. Only needed when the site address is not set in Settings > General.
